# Purpose

Award credit for a defensible hanger idealization, complete free-body diagram, correct internal resultants, explicit decomposition of the unsymmetric section, accurate centroid and second-moment calculations, correct selection of the governing extreme fiber, and a recommendation bounded by the stated assumptions.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes static loading, a fixed support at D, a concentrated vertical load at E, linear-elastic material response, small deformation, and straight-beam flexure at section a-a. It neglects self-weight, local weld and bolt behavior, chain dynamics, fatigue, impact, out-of-plane loading, contact, stress concentrations, curved-beam corrections, and applicable lifting-support standards.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

- context interpretation and load path: 20%;
- student idealization and assumptions: 20%;
- internal loading and composite-section properties: 35%;
- allowable-load result and stress interpretation: 15%;
- engineering assessment and limitations: 10%.
